answer.evidence: radon/complexity.py:10-12 defines the sort keys as lambdas: SCORE = -GET_COMPLEXITY(block), LINES = block.lineno, ALPHA = block.name. radon/complexity.py:59-75 sorted_results(blocks, order=SCORE) returns sorted(blocks, key=order). Review points: ALPHA is case-sensitive, so uppercase names sort before lowercase. SCORE has no tie-breaker, so equal-complexity blocks keep input order. The key lambdas assume blocks have .name, .lineno and complexity attributes. The docstring typo "sorty" at line 71 should be fixed. radon/cli/__init__.py:160 resolves the order via getattr(cc_mod, order.upper(), SCORE), so an unknown value silently falls back to SCORE. radon/visitors.py defines the Function and Class block objects that supply name, lineno and the complexity value, so the attribute types and the handling of nested or closure blocks need checking there. raw.py and metrics.py don't take part in this ordering path, so they get only a short check.
